offence_note: Two frauds, breaches of probation, copyright and trademark offences
sentence_quote: custodial sentence respecting the trademark and copyright offences is allowed and replaced by a custodial sentence of two months, to be served consecutively to his sentence on the fraud and breach of probation charges.
note: Total is 3x90 days plus 2 months consecutive; fine quashed; restitution via probation

sentence_quote: Leave to appeal is granted but the appeal is dismissed.

In all the circumstances, I find that the Crown’s recommendation of 12 months jail time, 36 months probation and the s. 380.2 and s. 487.04(a) orders, all ultimately agreed upon by the Defence, is just and reasonable.
note: Sentence already served; s. 380.2 prohibition order; restitution declined; Gladue treatment not clear in excerpts
